comment: One entry per PdfTextEngine.LayoutRevision: the SHA-256 (LF-normalised) of backend/src/OetLearner.Api/Services/Content/PdfPigPdfTextExtractor.cs at that revision. Changing the extractor's behaviour requires BOTH a LayoutRevision bump and a new entry here. Revision 1 was first recorded as 6e290e380a13ab92b587c5d425359e25616282e6ac46bbcf404fc6df589f4858; the PDF hardening layer then added ONE diagnostics-only call to ExtractAsync (PdfExtractionFacts.RecordEmbedded, which never touches the returned text), so the output is unchanged, the revision stays 1 and only the recorded hash moved. This mirrors KnownExtractorHashes in backend/tests/OetLearner.Api.Tests/RemoteJobs/RemoteEngineMigrationAndWiringTests.cs; keep the two in step. Inert manual reference: no workflow reads it.
